readings: Circuit is a two-stage shift register of ~a: q(n) = ~a(n-1).
Circuit is a set/hold/reset latch: q=1 if a=0 for two consecutive cycles, q=0 if a=1 for two consecutive cycles, else hold previous value.
Registers are uninitialized, so q is x until a known value propagates (matches waveform at t=0,5,10).
Registers are initialized to 0 (or 1), so q starts at 0 (or 1) instead of x.
